label: Sticky Add to Cart
purpose: Floating add-to-cart bar that appears when scrolling past the main buy buttons
_notes: None of show_on_mobile/show_on_desktop/show_product_image/show_price/show_variant_selector/position/button_label from the previous catalog version exist in the live schema anymore except button_label. function controls what clicking the bar's button actually does: add straight to cart, or scroll the page to a specific section (variant picker, quantity breaks table, or pricing table) instead of adding to cart. display_when controls whether the bar is always visible or only appears after scrolling past the main buy buttons. picker_type only affects whether the variant picker inside the bar is combined into one row or shown as separate pickers. stars_label is the inline_richtext caption next to the rating stars (default '(xxxx Reviews)' — write real review-count copy in the same shape, e.g. '(128 Reviews)'). Excluded as pure visual/composition: desktop_layout, desktop_show_image/title/rating_stars/price/sale_badge/variant_picker/full_button_width/show_price_in_button/transparent_bg and the matching mobile_* toggles, enable_custom_btn_color, custom_btn_color, color_scheme, star_color.
